Living in an area where mosquitoes and flying bugs seem to show up uninvited to every outdoor gathering, I was looking for something simple, effective, and low-maintenance.Setup was very straightforward — essentially plug and play. reviews.title: Sounds like a backyard fireworks show — in a good way
reviews.body: I bought two of these GOOTOP outdoor bug zappers to help control the nighttime bugs around my patio. I placed one about 50 feet out on each side of the patio, and so far they have made a dramatic difference.These things are beasts with bugs. At night it honestly sounds like a small fireworks show in the backyard. They have had no problem handling the bigger bugs along with the smaller ones, and the amount of bugs around the patio has dropped a lot since adding them.They are physically a little smaller than I expected, but they appear to work very well. At this price point, I would still be happy even if I only get a season or two out of them. I also added dusk-to-dawn sensors so they only run when needed, which should hopefully help them last longer.Things to know: they are not huge units, and I cannot speak to long-term durability yet.Final verdict: So far, so good. They work hard, they are affordable, and they have made a noticeable difference in my backyard bug problem. I will update later if they fail early or end up lasting for years.

reviews.title: It's a bug zapper. It zaps bugs. What more do you want.
reviews.body: Paid $39.99 for this and have zero complaints at that price. Plug it in, bugs fly into it, bugs get zapped. The 4200V grid does its thing, the satisfying zap sound confirms it's working, and the blue-violet glow provides a nice ambient light if you're sitting outside at night. It's also, let's be honest, mildly entertaining to listen to.The plug-in design keeps things simple — no batteries to replace, no charging to worry about. The removable tray and included brush make cleanup straightforward, which is not a small thing when you've been running this thing for a few nights and need to deal with the consequences.Worth noting that like most UV bug zappers it works best at night and in a dark environment — don't expect it to be pulling bugs away from you in broad daylight. And as with any bug zapper, moths seem to have more of a death wish than mosquitoes do, so results may vary depending on what specifically is bothering you.For the price though this is a solid, no-fuss outdoor pest control option that requires absolutely zero thought to operate. Sometimes that's all you need.
